def verify_heap(self,cold=False):
        require(self.word(WORK+4)==BUFFER+4096 and self.word(WORK+0x18)==BUFFER and
                [self.word(WORK+o)for o in [0x50,0x54,0x58]]==[8192,4096,4096],
                'Original single-extent heap metadata differs')
        require(self.word(BUFFER)==27 and self.word(BUFFER+0x78)==BUFFER+0x7c and
                [self.word(BUFFER+4096),self.word(BUFFER+4100)]==[0,4096],
                'Original private prefix/free header differs')
        nodes=[];p=self.word(0x2d226b4)
        while p:
            require(p in [0x3a7f150,0x3a7f160] and p not in [r['pointer']for r in nodes],
                    'New heap exit-list listener chain differs')
            words=struct.unpack('<4I',self.uc.mem_read(p,16))
            nodes.append(dict(pointer=p,words=[hex(v)for v in words]));p=words[0]
        require([r['pointer']for r in nodes]==[0x3a7f150,0x3a7f160] and
                nodes[0]['words'][1:]==['0x1000000','0x388b57','0x0'] and
                nodes[1]['words'][1:]==['0x3000000','0x388b37','0x0'],'Two original heap listeners differ')
        ops=[r for r in self.backend_initializations if r['native_caller']=='0x388bd0']
        require(len(ops)==1 and ops[0]['original_body_executed'] and len(ops[0]['native_zero_writes'])==6 and
                self.word(WORK+44)==0x388d00,'Original heap native init/retag not complete')
        require([r['native_return'] for r in self.listener_registrations]==['0x388be6','0x388bf8'],
                'Missing both original successful listener registration returns')
        expected_buffer=bytearray(b'\0'*4096+b'\xcc'*4096)
        for offset,value in [(0,27),(0x78,BUFFER+0x7c),(4096,0),(4100,4096)]:
            struct.pack_into('<I',expected_buffer,offset,value)
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(BUFFER,8192))==bytes(expected_buffer),
                'Whole declared extent differs from native prefix/free-page recipe')
        if cold:
            expected_work=bytearray(96)
            for offset,value in [(4,BUFFER+4096),(0x18,BUFFER),(0x2c,0x388d00),
                                 (0x50,8192),(0x54,4096),(0x58,4096)]:
                struct.pack_into('<I',expected_work,offset,value)
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(WORK,96))==bytes(expected_work),
                    'Whole cold native heap workspace differs from exact one-extent recipe')
        require(not any(self.task_mutex_ops.values()) and not any(self.mutexes.values()),'Heap ctor returned with an ordinary lock')
        return dict(workspace96_hex=bytes(self.uc.mem_read(WORK,96)).hex(),listeners=nodes,
            native_initializer=ops[0],declared_extent=[hex(BUFFER),8192],original_prefix_reserve_bytes=4096,
            whole_extent_matches_original_recipe=True,whole_cold_workspace_recipe_checked=cold,
            listener_registration_returns=self.listener_registrations,native_real_device_allocator_verified=False)

def verify_native_endpoint(self,gui_condition,before,timed):
        require(self.returned and self.running_task==self.controller==self.word(0xf09090) and
                self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC)==RETURN and self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)==self.controller,
                'Native settings failed to return on the actual controller stack')
        require(len(self.settings_init_rows)==5,'Missing original five settings initializer bodies')
        for caller,(pointer,tag) in INIT.items():
            rows=[r for r in self.settings_init_rows if r['native_caller']==hex(caller)]
            require(len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['original_body_executed'] and len(rows[0]['native_zero_writes'])==6,
                    'Original settings initializer six stores incomplete')
            uses=[r for r in self.settings_raw_mutex_operations if r['pointer']==hex(pointer)]
            expected=struct.pack('<6I',*[int(v,16) for v in uses[-1]['after_words']]) if uses else struct.pack('<6I',0,0,0,0,tag,0)
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==expected and
                    self.word(pointer+8)==self.word(pointer+12)==0 and self.word(pointer+16)==tag and
                    self.word(pointer+20)==0,'Released native settings semaphore differs from its actual epilogue')
        expected={COND:(gui_condition,self.timer_task+32,self.timer_task,0,0x2cbf8c,0),
            gui_condition:(0,COND,self.timer_task,0,0x6048e8,0),COND+28:(0,0,0,0,0x2cbf8c,0)}
        for pointer,words in expected.items():
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==struct.pack('<6I',*words),
                    'Native two-condition retained Timer chain differs '+hex(pointer))
        require(self.word(COND+24)==self.native_condition_magic and
                set(self.dispatcher_condition_tokens)=={COND,gui_condition},'Native condition token inventory differs')
        ctors=[r for r in self.condition_constructor_runs if r['pointer']==hex(COND)]
        transfers=[r for r in self.native_condition_owner_transfers if r['condition']==hex(COND)]
        locks=[r for r in self.native_mutex_runs if r['pointer']==hex(COND) and r['scope']=='condition_constructor']
        require(len(ctors)==len(transfers)==len(locks)==1 and ctors[0]['native_constructor_returned'] and
                ctors[0]['original_mutex_lock_and_owner_store_executed'] and locks[0]['native_body_returned'] and
                locks[0]['native_owner']==hex(self.controller) and transfers[0]['owner_matches_timer'] and
                self.native_semaphores[COND]['retained_condition_token'],
                'Original second condition constructor/lock/Timer transfer incomplete')
        pending=[self.task_mutex_ops,self.task_waits,self.task_releases,self.task_lower_waits,self.task_notifications]
        require(not any(any(values.values()) for values in pending) and not self.task_constructors and
                self.active_backend is None and self.active_list is None and not any(self.mutexes.values()),
                'Native endpoint has an unresolved operation or ordinary lock')
        require(all(r['native_body_returned'] for r in self.scoped_raw_ops+self.settings_raw_mutex_operations),
                'Scoped native raw mutex operation failed to reach its original epilogue')
        require(len(self.list_constructors)==2 and {int(r['pointer'],16) for r in self.list_constructors}==set(LISTS) and
                all(r['original_constructor_returned'] for r in self.list_constructors),
                'Original exit/settings list constructors did not both return')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(0x148e680,28))==struct.pack('<7I',0,0,0,0,0,0x3cc660,0),
                'Original unused settings list head/backend differs')
        for pointer in [WORK+28,0x2d226b8]:
            uses=[r for r in self.scoped_raw_ops if r['pointer']==hex(pointer)]
            tag=0x388d00 if pointer==WORK+28 else 0x3cc660
            expected_raw=struct.pack('<6I',*[int(v,16) for v in uses[-1]['after_words']]) if uses else struct.pack('<6I',0,0,0,0,tag,0)
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==expected_raw and self.word(pointer+8)==self.word(pointer+12)==0 and
                    self.word(pointer+16)==tag and self.word(pointer+20)==0,
                    'Heap/list released backend differs from its observed native epilogue')
        after=self.native_task_inventory()
        require(after['all_tasks']==before['all_tasks'] and after['ready']==before['ready'],
                'Settings changed native ALL/ready membership')
        resident=[]
        for old,new in zip(before['tasks'],after['tasks']):
            task=int(old['TCB'],16);raw=bytearray.fromhex(old['raw108_hex'])
            require(task in self.native_TCBs and self.declared_storage(task,108),'Missing original native TCB lifetime')
            if task==self.timer_task:struct.pack_into('<I',raw,32,COND)
            for offset in [56,80]:
                pointer=task+offset
                uses=[r for r in self.scoped_raw_ops if r['pointer']==hex(pointer)]
                if uses:
                    require(task==self.controller and offset==56,'Unexpected internal semaphore use')
                    expected_raw=struct.pack('<6I',*[int(v,16) for v in uses[-1]['after_words']])
                    require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==expected_raw,'Whole internal semaphore differs from its native epilogue')
                    raw[offset:offset+8]=expected_raw[:8]
                require(self.word(pointer+8)==self.word(pointer+12)==0 and self.word(pointer+20)==0 and
                        self.word(pointer+16)==self.internal_tags[pointer],
                        'Native internal semaphore owner/waiter/depth/tag differs')
            require(bytes(raw)==bytes.fromhex(new['raw108_hex']),
                    'Whole native TCB changed outside exact retained head/internal stale links '+old['TCB'])
            require(self.word(task+32)==(COND if task==self.timer_task else 0),
                    'Final native task owned head differs')
            if task!=self.controller:
                require(old['saved_frame']==new['saved_frame'] and
                        old['saved_frame13_words']==new['saved_frame13_words'],
                        'Resident background original frame changed '+old['TCB'])
                resident.append(dict(TCB=old['TCB'],frame=new['saved_frame'],raw13=new['saved_frame13_words']))
        thread=int(timed['thread'],16)
        require(self.timed_thread_inventory(thread)==timed,'Original timed Thread node/context/virtual clock changed')
        owned=set()
        for task in self.native_TCBs:
            pointer=self.word(task+32);prev=task+32
            while pointer:
                require(pointer in self.native_semaphores and pointer not in owned and len(owned)<16 and
                        self.word(pointer+4)==prev and self.word(prev)==pointer and self.word(pointer+8)==task and
                        self.word(pointer+12)==0,'Native retained owned semaphore chain malformed')
                owned.add(pointer);prev=pointer;pointer=self.word(pointer)
        require(owned=={COND,gui_condition} and
                {p for p in self.native_semaphores if self.word(p+8)}==owned,
                'Registered native semaphore owners disagree with exact owned chains')
        require(not self.condition_bootstrap_tokens,'Inherited fake settings constructor lock was used')
        return dict(native_inventory=after,whole_TCB108_compared_with_exact_native_deltas=True,
            resident_four_frames=resident,timed_thread=timed,controller_old_WAIT_frame_consumed=True,
            actual_controller_SP=hex(self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)),condition_constructor=ctors[0],
            native_token_lock=locks[0],native_Timer_transfer=transfers[0],
            original_lists=self.list_constructors,inherited_settings_ret0_lock_used=False,
            real_allocator_release_or_physical_device_boot_verified=False)

def journal_mutable_write(self, uc, access, address, size, value, data):
        if not self.mutable_journal_active:
            return
        pc = uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC)
        thumb=bool(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_CPSR)&32)
        opcode=self.stock.read(pc,4)
        instructions=list(self.store_disassemblers[thumb].disasm(opcode,pc,count=1))
        require(self.mutable_bank_start <= address and address+size <= self.mutable_bank_start+self.mutable_bank_size
                and size in [1,2,4] and len(instructions)==1,
                'Mutable initialized-data write crosses declared scope')
        instruction=instructions[0]
        require(bytes(uc.mem_read(pc,instruction.size))==opcode[:instruction.size] and
                instruction.mnemonic.startswith(('str','stm','swp')),
                'Mutable-data writer opcode differs from original MAIN store instruction')
        require(len(self.mutable_cpu_stores) < 10000, 'Native settings write journal budget exhausted')
        before = bytes(uc.mem_read(address,size))
        self.mutable_cpu_stores.append(dict(PC=hex(pc),address=hex(address),size=size,
            before_hex=before.hex(),value=value, running_task=hex(self.running_task),
            Thumb=thumb,original_instruction=instruction.mnemonic+' '+instruction.op_str,
            original_opcode_hex=opcode[:instruction.size].hex()))

def verify_mutable_scope(self):
        require(self.mutable_journal_active and self.mutable_bank_before is not None, 'Missing mutable-data scope')
        expected = bytearray(self.mutable_bank_before)
        for row in self.mutable_cpu_stores:
            offset = int(row['address'],16)-self.mutable_bank_start; size=row['size']
            require(expected[offset:offset+size].hex() == row['before_hex'], 'CPU write history omits an intervening host write')
            expected[offset:offset+size] = int(row['value']).to_bytes(size,'little')
        actual = bytes(self.uc.mem_read(self.mutable_bank_start,self.mutable_bank_size))
        require(actual == bytes(expected), 'Whole initialized-data bank differs outside observed original CPU stores')
        return dict(start=hex(self.mutable_bank_start),bytes=self.mutable_bank_size,
            before_sha256=hashlib.sha256(self.mutable_bank_before).hexdigest(),
            after_sha256=hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),CPU_store_count=len(self.mutable_cpu_stores),
            original_store_PCs=sorted({r['PC'] for r in self.mutable_cpu_stores}),stores=self.mutable_cpu_stores,
            whole_bank_matches_original_CPU_write_history=True,host_unrecorded_mutation=False,
            native_PC_from_exact_MAIN=True,all_RAM_or_physical_flash_verified=False)

def fonts(self):
        result=[]
        for n in range(13):
            metadata=0x14b3c60+64*n;record=0x14b4014+0x330*n;context=self.word(record)
            result.append({'index':n,'metadata':hex(metadata),'record':hex(record),
                'context':hex(context),'metadata_flags':list(self.uc.mem_read(metadata+0x3c,2)),
                'metadata_words34_38':[hex(self.word(metadata+0x34)),hex(self.word(metadata+0x38))],
                'name':self.ascii(metadata),'context_error':hex(self.word(context+0x24))if context else None,
                'source_metadata':hex(self.word(record+4))})
        return result

def observe(self, uc, address, size, data):
        if address in [0x14093e, 0x14098c, 0x1409be, 0x140936, 0x1409d0,
            0x14f034, 0x14f084, 0x266a82, 0x2654e4, 0x26887a]:
            self.native_font_file_calls.append(dict(entry=hex(address),
                arguments=[uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS], caller=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1)))
        kind = FONT_IO.get(address)
        if self.external_IO_active and kind:
            args = [uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS]
            caller=uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1
            owns_call=(kind=='open' and caller==0x140978) or (kind!='open' and args[0] in self.external_files)
            if not owns_call:
                self.external_file_requests.append(dict(operation='delegate_non_font_'+kind,
                    boundary=hex(address),arguments=args,caller=hex(caller),
                    inherited_original_backend_retained=True))
                return super().observe(uc,address,size,data)
            if kind == 'open':
                path = self.wide(args[0])
                require(path in self.backup_paths and args[1] == 1, 'Unexpected font open path/mode')
                if path in self.raw_font_sources:
                    handle = 0x09110000+len(self.external_files)*0x40
                    self.external_files[handle] = dict(path=path, position=0, closed=False)
                    self.put(args[2], handle)
                    result = 0
                else:
                    handle = 0
                    self.put(args[2], 0)
                    result = 1
                row = dict(operation=kind, path=path, handle=hex(handle), result=result,
                    original_font_path_conversion_executed=True,
                    absent_file_is_absent_from_exact_backup=not bool(handle))
            else:
                handle = args[0]
                require(handle in self.external_files, 'Unknown virtual font file handle')
                entry = self.external_files[handle]
                require(not entry['closed'], 'Use of closed virtual font file')
                raw = self.raw_font_sources[entry['path']]
                row = dict(operation=kind, handle=hex(handle), path=entry['path'],
                    position_before=entry['position'])
                if kind == 'read':
                    require(0 <= args[2] <= 0x100000, 'Unexpected font file read size')
                    available = min(args[2], max(0, len(raw)-entry['position']))
                    chunk = raw[entry['position']:entry['position']+available]
                    if chunk:
                        self.map_verified_file_destination(args[1],len(chunk))
                        try:uc.mem_write(args[1], chunk)
                        except Exception:
                            row.update(failed_read_arguments=args,destination=hex(args[1]),requested_bytes=args[2],returned_bytes=available)
                            self.external_file_requests.append(row)
                            raise
                    entry['position'] += available
                    result = available
                    row.update(requested_bytes=args[2], returned_bytes=available,
                        destination=hex(args[1]), supplied_raw_bytes_SHA256=hashlib.sha256(chunk).hexdigest(),
                        host_decoded_font_bytes_supplied=False)
                elif kind == 'seek':
                    offset = args[2]+(args[3]<<32)
                    if offset >= 1<<63:
                        offset -= 1<<64
                    origin = self.word(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP))
                    require(origin in [0, 1, 2], 'Unexpected font seek origin')
                    position = [0, entry['position'], len(raw)][origin]+offset
                    require(0 <= position <= len(raw), 'Font seek outside exact backup file')
                    entry['position'] = position
                    result = 0
                    row.update(signed_offset=offset, origin=origin, position_after=position)
                elif kind == 'tell':
                    result = entry['position']
                    uc.reg_write(REGS[1], 0)
                else:
                    entry['closed'] = True
                    result = 0
            self.visits[address] += 1
            row.update(boundary=hex(address), generic_file_manager_fixture=True,
                caller=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1))
            self.external_file_requests.append(row)
            self.ret(result)
            return
        return super().observe(uc, address, size, data)

def observe(self,uc,address,size,data):
        if self.root_probe_active:
            if address==0x529814:
                self.visits[address]+=1;self.ret(self.root_policy);return
            if address==0x6a56d8:
                self.visits[address]+=1
                args=[uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS]
                label=args[3];shared=self.word(label+8)
                require(args[1]==PLAYER_ID and shared!=0,'Wrong Add constructor endpoint')
                self.root_endpoint={'entry':hex(address),'id':args[1],
                    'caption':self.wide(shared+8),'caption_auxiliary':self.word(label+16),
                    'constructor_executed':False,'full_Add_function_returned':False,
                    'stack_args':[self.word(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)+n*4) for n in range(3)]}
                uc.emu_stop();return
        name=self.sql_hooks.get(address) if hasattr(self,'sql_hooks') else None
        if name is None:return super().observe(uc,address,size,data)
        self.visits[address]+=1
        args=[uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS]
        value=0
        if name=='prepare':
            require(args[0]==DB and args[2]==0xffffffff,'Unexpected native sqlite prepare ABI')
            sql=self.ascii(args[1])
            require(sql in ['SELECT icon, size FROM custom_table WHERE id = ?',
                           'UPDATE custom_table SET icon = ?, size = ? WHERE id = ?'],
                    'Unexpected SQL from original formatter: '+sql)
            statement=SQL_BASE+0x200+len(self.statements)*0x40
            require(statement+0x40<SQL_BASE+0x4000,'Statement inventory exhausted')
            self.put(statement,DB)
            self.statements[statement]={'sql':sql,'bound':{},'cursor':None,'row':None,'closed':False}
            self.put(args[3],statement)
            self.sql_events.append({'operation':'prepare_engine_fixture','SQL':sql,'statement':hex(statement)})
        elif name=='bind64':
            row=self.statements[args[0]]
            require(not row['closed'] and 1<=args[1]<=row['sql'].count('?'),'Bad SQLite parameter index')
            raw=args[2] | args[3]<<32
            signed=raw if raw<1<<63 else raw-(1<<64)
            row['bound'][args[1]]=signed
            self.sql_events.append({'operation':'bind64_engine_fixture','index':args[1],'value':signed})
        elif name=='step':
            row=self.statements[args[0]];require(not row['closed'],'Step on closed statement')
            if row['cursor'] is None:
                require(len(row['bound'])==row['sql'].count('?'),'Native bind did not fill query')
                row['cursor']=self.db.execute(row['sql'],tuple(row['bound'][n] for n in range(1,len(row['bound'])+1)))
            row['row']=row['cursor'].fetchone()
            value=100 if row['row'] is not None else 101  # SQLITE_ROW / SQLITE_DONE
            self.sql_events.append({'operation':'step_engine_fixture','SQLite_result':value})
        elif name=='column_int':
            row=self.statements[args[0]]
            require(not row['closed'] and row['row'] is not None and args[1] in [0,1],'Invalid column read')
            value=int(row['row'][args[1]])&0xffffffff
        elif name=='finalize':
            row=self.statements[args[0]];require(not row['closed'],'Statement finalized twice')
            if row['cursor'] is not None:row['cursor'].close()
            row['closed']=True;self.sql_events.append({'operation':'finalize_engine_fixture'})
        elif name=='completion':
            # Original prepare/step calls this OS notification on all results.
            # No SQLITE_BUSY injection or wait/thread scheduling is claimed.
            self.sql_events.append({'operation':'completion_notification_fixture'})
        else:
            require(args[0]==self.menu_pointer() and args[3]==0,'Unexpected normal widget factory ABI')
            self.widget_boundaries.append({'entry':hex(address),'registry':args[0],
                'output':args[1],'catalog_index':args[2],'mode':args[3],
                'fifth_argument':self.word(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)),
                'widget_constructed':False})
            # Do not manufacture a Widget, vtable or rendered control. The
            # native getter ignores this return and independently reports match.
        self.ret(value)

def verify_memory(self,voice,exports,dbsha):
        require(not self.invalid_accesses and not self.native_fatal_entries and not self.audio,'Runtime fault or unexpected audio request')
        oldram=struct.unpack_from('<I',(ROOT/self.build['original_binary']).read_bytes(),4)[0]
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(IMAGE+12,oldram-12))==voice and bytes(self.uc.mem_read(STUBS,480))==exports,
            'Whole original voice RAM or40 exports changed')
        tables={}
        for table,names in [('app_component_api',self.build['private_api']),('player_component_api',self.build['player_api'])]:
            values=list(struct.unpack('<'+str(len(names))+'I',self.uc.mem_read(self.symbol(table),4*len(names))))
            require(values==[self.symbol(n)for n in names],'Whole compiled private/player API table changed')
            tables[table]=[hex(v)for v in values]
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(self.build['extension_base'],0x10000))==self.extension_code,'Whole RX extension code changed')
        for address,raw in self.initial_regions.items():
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(address,len(raw)))==raw,'Whole original initialized code/GUI region changed '+hex(address))
        for address,raw in self.code_images:
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(address,len(raw)))==raw,'Whole original code image changed '+hex(address))
        require(not self.conditional_region_writes,'Kernel singleton bootstrap unexpectedly mutated declared GUI initialized region')
        for ptr,entry in self.raw_allocations.items():self.verify_guard(ptr,entry)
        for entry in self.handles.values():
            p,n=entry['pointer'],entry['length']
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(p-32,32))==b'\xa5'*32 and bytes(self.uc.mem_read(p+n,32))==b'\xa5'*32,
                'Whole opaque allocation canary changed')
        self.verify_storage_guards();self.verify_descriptor_guards();self.verify_closed_files()
        for bottom in [CONTROLLER_STACK,IDLE_STACK]:
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(bottom,64))==b'\xa5'*64,'Synthetic stack leading64 canary changed')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(0x2d226f4,24))==b'\xa5'*24,'Native timer stack leading24 canary changed')
        for row in self.GUI_stack_canaries:
            require(row.get('whole16384_native_fill_verified') and
                bytes(self.uc.mem_read(int(row['bottom'],16),64)).hex()==row['leading64_after_native_fill_hex'],
                'Original GUI stack crossed its observed leading64 boundary')
        require(len(self.GUI_stack_canaries)==2,'Missing both original GUI stack boundary snapshots')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(CODE,8))==struct.pack('<2I',0xeafffffe,0xe12fff1e),'Declared synthetic code sentinels changed')
